# Let's search for the next few songs and collect their IDs.
# We'll define a helper to find the exact match from search results.
def find_song_id(search_results, title, artist):
    for song in search_results:
        if song['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            song_artists = [a['name'].lower() for a in song['artists']]
            # Check if all artists in the query are present
            query_artists = [a.strip().lower() for a in artist.split(',')]
            if all(qa in song_artists for qa in query_artists):
                return song['song_id']
    return None

# Search for songs 3-6
song_ids = {songs[0]['title']: 154}  # already known
for i in range(1, len(songs)):
    title = songs[i]['title']
    artist = songs[i]['artist']
    query = f"{title} {artist}"
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, access_token=spotify_token)
    sid = find_song_id(results, title, artist)
    if sid:
        song_ids[title] = sid
        print(f"Found: {title} -> {sid}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {title}")

print("Collected song_ids:", song_ids)

        if song['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            song_artists = [a['name'].lower() for a in song['artists']]
            # Check if all artists in the query are present
            query_artists = [a.strip().lower() for a in artist.split(',')]
            if all(qa in song_artists for qa in query_artists):
